Precomputed Radiance Transfer (PRT) is a technique that models light interaction with surfaces using transfer functions to map incoming light to a description of radiance distribution, rather than operating on actual radiance values directly [S1, unofficial].

The claim accurately reflects the content of Source [S1]. The source explicitly states that PRT aims to 'model how light interacts with surfaces without operating on actual radiance values' and that 'Transfer functions allow us to do this, they allow us to turn incoming light into a description of how radiance is distributed throughout a scene.' This matches the claim's description of using transfer functions to map incoming light to a description of radiance distribution rather than operating on actual radiance values directly.
